milestones.title: Multi-sensor data pipeline operational; Data Management Plan delivered
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, soil-sensor and weather data are ingested, quality-controlled and harmonised over the field boundaries on the geospatial/time-series platform; the Data Management Plan is delivered as an open-science deliverable by month 6.
source_vault_nodes: Geospatial and Time Series Data Platform (METH-INFRA-005)
milestones.note: The DMP-by-month-6 element is the MSCA-PF open-science structural requirement (sub-section 1.2).

milestones.title: Diagnostic method v1 producing calibrated field-state posteriors
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Route A and/or Route B produce posterior estimates of the target latent field state (e.g. root-zone soil moisture, crop water stress) with explicit uncertainty over at least one growing season's data; route scope (RQ2) and field-state definition (RQ3) recorded as decided.

milestones.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine integrated
milestones.verifiable_criterion: AquaCrop is calibrated retaining an honest parameter posterior; counterfactual irrigation simulations run over weather ensembles; the profit-based recommendation logic selects decisions by expected economic return under uncertainty, end to end from a diagnosed state.

milestones.title: Standalone research demonstrator exercises the end-to-end pipeline
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The web MVP runs the full observation-to-decision pipeline and presents irrigation recommendations with their uncertainty for at least one field case; TRL target (RQ10) recorded.
source_vault_nodes: Web MVP and User Interface Layer (METH-INFRA-010)
milestones.note: Demonstrator framing is vault synthesis; TRL target Unresolved.
